subject: Re: Latent-shift status: readout framing + Q3 commitment
body:
Team,

Locking the Jun 24 readout framing.

Recommendation going in: productionize as a monitoring/alerting layer first, not an auto-adaptation layer. The "9 days before on-call" result is the story — we sell early detection, and the adaptation step stays human-approved for at least two quarters. Freya's proxy-strength diagnostic is a hard gate in the design: no proxy signal, no subgroup claims, and the dashboard says so explicitly.

Q3 OKR language (lock is Jun 26, so this is final by Wednesday): "Latent-shift monitoring live on three platform model families with replay-validated detection." Sized against the validation plan Santiago costed — the readout includes that budget line as already socialized with finance.

Kaia/Freya — one joint slide on the eigendecomposition-vs-WAE choice please; leadership will ask why we picked the interpretable one and the answer is good.

Dmitri
